source.title: Carroll County government agencies involved in development review

jurisdictions.name: Carroll County Bureau of Development Review
jurisdictions.description: Environmental Site Delineation (ESD). Required before most site plan submittals.

jurisdictions.name: Carroll County Bureau of Permits and Inspections
jurisdictions.description: Building permits for all construction within Town limits, including properties in Frederick County.

jurisdictions.name: Carroll County Bureau of Resource Management
jurisdictions.description: Grading permits after site plan approval. Stormwater management and sediment control review.
